legend-val-d-orcia-scenic-road.story: curated scenic road. Tuscan hills, cypress roads, wine villages. A one-way ride of 57 km, Siena to Montepulciano - roughly 1 h 02 in the saddle. On the way it passes Buonconvento, Montalcino and Pienza. The line favours views over speed.
